label: Non-bank low-doc
description: Specialist non-bank asset financiers. Slightly higher rates than the banks, more flexible on deposit, property ownership and asset type.

lowDoc.minDeposit: Often none with clean bank statement conduct
lowDoc.creditFileRequirement: Clean or near-clean; small paid defaults sometimes considered with explanation
lowDoc.typicalTurnaround: Same business day to two business days

notes: Wider asset appetite: specialised or older equipment that banks decline.
Rates typically sit above the bank tier; AssetMX still adds no margin.
Bank statements are the primary serviceability evidence.
